answer: Each identity burns a deposit for a vertex in the dune-garden map, locking 70. It rises like a dune: first 40, kth 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes burn 3,037,000, lock 70,000 vs 40,000 pool. The owner works its garden plot each epoch with a key-signed proof or loses bond and plot. One key, one vertex: two on one plot burn both. A rented proof never matches the plot key, so rented-plot rings fail; auditors replay the garden map. Honest agents burn 40 once.
